project_type: Static website - single-page scrollytelling experience (Vite + vanilla JS + Three.js)
build_system: Vite for dev server and production bundling
test_framework: None - visual prototype, validation is build success and manual inspection
test_command: npm run build (no unit tests for visual prototype)
verification_instructions: 1. Run npm install, 2. Run npm run build, 3. Verify dist/ directory is created with index.html and bundled assets, 4. Optionally run npm run preview to check locally
snapshot_or_generated_files: dist/ directory is the build output but should NOT be checked in (added to .gitignore). GitHub Pages will deploy from gh-pages branch or GitHub Actions.
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET - full network access, can install any npm packages. Node.js v22 available. Target deployment: GitHub Pages (static files only).
contribution_requirements: No CONTRIBUTING.md exists. Fresh greenfield project.
key_patterns: Vite project structure: index.html at root, src/ for JS/CSS modules, public/ for static assets. Three.js for 3D globe. GSAP + ScrollTrigger for scroll-driven animations. No frameworks (React/Vue) - vanilla JS for simplicity and performance.
directory_structure: / - project root with index.html, vite.config.js, package.json; /src - JavaScript modules and CSS; /public - static assets (textures, images); /.github/workflows - GitHub Actions for Pages deployment
